Vote brigading is as much freedom of speech as grabbing a megaphone and bellowing "LA LA LA LA LA!" at the top of your lungs is. Those of us who are genuinely desperate for freedom of speech want it so that we can share our thoughts and feelings without fear of being dragged into the streets and shot. Yes, but there's a great deal of overlap between "exercising free speech" and "being a dick to people".

Brigading is not an individual action. It is more properly categorized as freedom of assembly. It is all but impossible to set up rules that can differentiate between brigading and spontaneous outrage. Within the context of online communities, I think the only solution is a more educated and suspicious user base that is able to see when they are being manipulated to amplify a minority signal. It's just another skill we need to develop like media bias awareness or the ability to spot spam and astroturfing. It is just the cost of doing business in an open forum.
